minor.issue: Booking doc is inserted with status 'pending' BEFORE the USDT debit. If the process crashes/raises between insert_one and debit_balance_idempotent (non-'insufficient' failure), an UNPAID pending booking remains; a later reject/cancel/cron-expire calls _refund and credits money that was never charged. Suggest inserting with a transient status (e.g. 'reserving', counted as occupied) and flipping to 'pending' only after debit 'applied'/'duplicate', and/or having _refund verify the pay op_id was applied before crediting.

Accept only checks slot start, not accept_deadline_utc. For slots >48h away, a company can accept after the 48h deadline if the cron hasn't run yet (race with auto-expire). Consider rejecting accept when now > accept_deadline_utc.

Reject of an ACCEPTED booking has no time check — company can reject (refund customer) after the appointment has passed but before the settle cron runs. UI hides Rechazar for accepted bookings, so backend/UI are inconsistent; decide policy and enforce in backend.
